caption: Ponte degli Alpini, Bassano del Grappa
composition: Palladio wooden covered bridge over the Brenta · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the riverbank the camera looks along the Ponte degli Alpini, its long wooden covered deck with open trussed sides stretching from the left across the Brenta. Massive stone piers anchor it with their reflection in the calm water, while Monte Grappa rises behind on the right above the town and trees. The 10:22 morning sun shines on the timber.
